notes: Added 2026-10-20 ~23:05Z (ML-unblock subagent). q0116c attempt 1 (22:58Z) died in 1.3 s: discover_captures -> sidecar_version -> forecast.require_local on 20261011T123356Z_9cd3cdb9/rows_ext.csv.gz (manifest and ext_manifest kept by the 8-day snapshot rule, sidecar archived). Host inventory 23:00Z: 118 complete snapshots; 10 without any sidecar (10-10/10-11 morning, not checked), 8 with ext_manifest but no rows_ext (these 8, all in data-20261015-dsheikh), 100 with both. The run itself does not read these 8: the gate picks the longest consecutive sidecar run, which is the 78 captures 2026-10-14T12:31Z .. 2026-10-20T22:31Z, all fully on the host; the older run (29 captures, 10-11T14:30Z .. 10-13T22:31Z) only has to be discoverable. Only rows_ext.csv.gz is restored (discovery checks its existence; rows.csv.gz is never opened for non-run captures). Restored copies keep the archive mtime, so the nightly 03:30Z archive_rotate (8-day snapshot rule) removes them again tonight; that is intended (no retention change): q0116d reads them only during discovery, seconds after it starts, and the start blackout (02:45-05:30Z) means it either starts before 02:45Z or waits. The same 03:30Z rotation also archives the sidecars of 10-12T04:31Z .. 10-13T02:31Z, so a q0116d start after tonight's rotation would need a wider restore (see q0116d notes).
